note.label: A note from us
note.body: We made dewstick because we wanted a lip mask we could actually wear out the door: squalane, shea butter and ceramides underneath, real colour on top. Try it and tell us what you think — your words will be the first this space holds.

philosophy.text: Half the tube is lipstick. The other half does the work of a $30 lip mask — squalane for deep hydration, shea butter for softness, ceramides to strengthen and protect. All the care. All the colour.
